fields.Name: T44 - Data Explorer Sort Courses
fields.Description: Verifies that clicking the Code or Title column header in the Courses grid sorts the rows and reorders the grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K global search) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree open the 'Courses' entity. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Then click the Code or Title column header to sort the grid by that column. Success is reached when the chosen column shows a sort indicator and the row order visibly reorders.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Courses entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
The Code or Title column header has been clicked and shows a sort indicator (ascending or descending arrow)
The grid row order reflects the applied sort
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
